scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation with exact symbolic finite-instance verification; literature overlap assessment is self-review only. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to isotropic SPD quadratics, independent centered finite-variance per-query noise, fresh sign-balanced isotropic scaled-orthogonal frames, and squared Euclidean error. The reported direction-count-invariant floor is at the fastest homogeneous mean-square contraction step, not the global minimum over stepsizes. Does not establish a full stationary distribution, a general-Hessian result, or exhaustive publication priority.
title: Exact query-noise universality for structured zeroth-order descent on isotropic quadratics
